scope: Final independent source review of Main Dino Detective and Hangman progress/reward receipt integration. App and shared reward helper were inspected only as integration touchpoints. No browser/build/runtime acceptance is implied.

blockers.finding: Dino stores and validates only the latest eight completion receipts, while its 12 worlds can each produce up to three positive star-improvement receipts (up to 36). When the parent reward claim fails, the durable receipt is the recovery source across Back/reopen, but the map still permits starting unlocked worlds while a pending reward exists. More than eight subsequent positive completions can evict an unresolved receipt; then reopening cannot reconcile it and its parent reward is permanently lost. Retain all bounded possible positive receipts (or a separate unresolved-claim ledger) and gate continued runs while a claim remains unresolved.

reviewedIntegration: Main Dino uses stable transaction tokens for parent reward claims, retries the held result, and reconciles durable positive receipts on map entry. Hangman commits/readbacks its level before claiming, retries the same attempt token, reconciles positive receipts on mount/map entry, enforces strict known-field validation, preserves unknown canonical metadata and raw legacy state, and its 20 transaction window exceeds the maximum 12 positive best-improvement receipts (three score tiers across four levels). Shared reward-token processing remains idempotent and App returns its persistence result to both callers.
acceptanceBoundary: Independent source review only. No tests, browser, build, deployment, or native acceptance were performed by this reviewer.

reviewDeltas.scope: Recheck of Dino reward-receipt retention, exact read-only legacy collection compatibility, and Hangman skip/distinct-rescue/pool corrections only.
reviewDeltas.resolution: Resolved in the reviewed source: all positive receipts are retained up to 12 worlds × 3 possible best-star improvements; only the latest eight zero-delta receipts are pruned. The focused stress regression fills all 36 positive slots, adds zero-delta replays, and verifies the first positive receipt remains reconcilable.
reviewDeltas.compatibilityBoundary: The collection getter fallback is limited to the exact three-key version-1 partial record with an ordered known completed prefix and exactly matching stickers. It returns read-only shelf state; transactional reads and commits remain strict and the test asserts malformed compatibility bytes are preserved with zero writes.
reviewDeltas.hangmanReview: The queue contains only explicit taught-grapheme spellings and validated regular-cluster records; the themed map excludes untaught irregular forms. Per-run rescued IDs prevent duplicate solves from increasing the target count, and nextHangmanWordIndex skips rescued entries while wrapping to remaining unrescued words. The compact mobile utility row uses 48px minimum-height controls with full aria-labels.
reviewDeltas.sourceReview: The prior Dino receipt-retention blocker is resolved; no concrete blocker was found in the three requested deltas.
reviewDeltas.acceptanceBoundary: Focused source-only delta review; tests were not run by this reviewer. Root's compiled/native/public gates remain separate.
